name: marital-matchmaker
description: AI-powered compatibility engine for finding life partners. Combines deep compatibility quizzes across 5 dimensions (Values, Goals, Communication, Lifestyle, Finance) with profile browsing and in-app messaging. Intent questionnaire ensures users are serious about marriage.

userStories.title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the base Next.js 14 project configured with Supabase, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui for the matchmaking platform.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 app created with App Router
Supabase client configured with environment variables
Tailwind CSS configured with romantic/elegant color palette (deep purples, golds, soft pinks)
shadcn/ui initialized with button, card, input, form, avatar, badge components
Base layout with responsive container created
Environment variables template (.env.example) created
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Database Schema Design
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the complete database schema for user profiles, compatibility scores, and messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: users_extended table (id, user_id, display_name, age, gender, location, bio, photos_json, intent_verified, created_at)
compatibility_quiz_responses table (id, user_id, dimension, question_id, answer_value, created_at)
compatibility_dimensions table (id, name: values/goals/communication/lifestyle/finance, weight, description)
quiz_questions table (id, dimension_id, question_text, answer_options_json, scoring_logic)
matches table (id, user1_id, user2_id, compatibility_score, dimension_scores_json, status, created_at)
conversations table (id, match_id, created_at)
messages table (id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, read_at, created_at)
user_preferences table (id, user_id, min_age, max_age, preferred_location, dealbreakers_json)
intent_responses table (id, user_id, marriage_timeline, relationship_history, what_seeking, created_at)
likes table (id, from_user_id, to_user_id, created_at)
blocks table (id, blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at)
Row Level Security policies for all tables
Seed data for 5 compatibility dimensions with descriptions
Seed data for 25 quiz questions (5 per dimension)
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Intent Questionnaire
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to complete an intent questionnaire to verify my serious interest in marriage.
acceptanceCriteria: Intent questionnaire page at /onboarding/intent as first onboarding step
Question 1: Marriage timeline (1 year, 2-3 years, when right person, unsure)
